description: This file defines the SupportsPushDownJoin interface, a mix-in for ScanBuilder in Spark SQL, enabling push-down join operations in data sources.

classes.name: SupportsPushDownJoin
classes.description: An interface for data sources to implement join push-down capabilities.

classes.name: ColumnWithAlias
classes.description: A record class used to handle duplicated column names from join sides, holding original column name and alias.

methods.name: isOtherSideCompatibleForJoin
methods.description: Checks if the other join side is compatible for push-down join.

methods.name: pushDownJoin
methods.description: Attempts to push down a join operation with specified parameters.
